main.description: Exchange a one-use ATProto service-auth JWT for a short-lived, MAC-labeled hyprstream bearer session credential.

scope.description: Optional attenuation of the fixed transition:generic exchange grant.

audience.description: Optional RFC 8707 resource indicator for the issued credential.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The service-auth JWT is invalid, expired, or already used.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The requested tenant, scope, or audience is invalid.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: The host could not issue a credential.
